##### Project general facts

Arabian Ranches is an exclusive coastal development created by Reportage Group in partnership with RS Capital Investment along the scenic shores of the Caspian Sea. Representing a harmonious symphony of two worlds, the project blends traditional Eastern architectural heritage with modern sophistication and coastal comfort. Set on a total plot area of 34,008.98 sq. m, the complex features 970 apartments (including studios, one, two, and three-bedroom options) and 55 luxurious triplex four-bedroom townhouses.

Residents are offered a wide range of world-class amenities designed for relaxation and an active lifestyle. The community provides private parking spaces, swimming pools, a state-of-the-art fitness center and gym, multi-purpose sports courts, kids' play areas, and landscaped gardens. Additionally, outdoor barbecue areas, walking and cycling tracks, 24/7 security, and concierge services ensure absolute convenience and peace of mind.

Every residence is meticulously designed to maximize natural light and coziness. The finishing and equipment include private balconies and terraces, kitchen cabinets with countertops, fully tiled bathrooms with showers, as well as built-in wardrobes. Furthermore, all residential units are equipped with a central heating and cooling system, and the spacious townhouses feature premium finishes and rooftop terraces.

##### Parking
Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

The project is located in the prestigious Sea Breeze Resort area along the Caspian Sea near Baku, the dynamic capital of Azerbaijan known for its rich history, unique culture, and striking architecture. This ideal location combines the charm of Eastern traditions with a modern lifestyle, creating a unique environment for living, working, and exploring the Caucasus region.

The location provides excellent accessibility and proximity to key infrastructure for the whole family. The Landau School and kids' club are within a 10-minute drive, while the famous DreamFest area, circus, water park, SPA center, and Amburan Mall are a 15 to 20-minute drive away.

Thanks to this prime location, residents can easily combine a secluded seaside retreat with active urban living. The international airport is reachable in about 40 minutes by car, providing comfortable conditions for travel and permanent residence in one of the most attractive coastal regions.
